summary: A hand-percussion rhythm box for accompanying songs in a circle, with djembe, cajon, udu and others, a berimbau page with a capoeira bateria, and tanpura and shruti box drones.
features: Six percussion instruments with real strokes, velocity on the black keys
Step sequencer on the white keys; live recording into the loop
32 rhythms of 2 to 8 beats; 9 slots for your own
Berimbau page with 11 toques and the capoeira bateria
Synthesised tanpura and shruti box drones, alone or under the rhythm
Changes land on the bar; tap tempo and a slowly rising tempo

headings: fm-1delrio: a ceremony rhythm box for the m-vave fm-1
